message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. MFA for administrators blocks access to both DC and ADFS, preventing admin_dc and admin_adfs. MFA for database administrators then blocks authentication to the database, file server, and backup, even if CI leaks database credentials. Thus all exfiltration techniques are unreachable. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI credential-leak path open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administrator access; segmented alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation or laptop. Any single patch or mfa:user leaves a phishing-to-internal-access path through service authentication, Kerberoasting, DC administrator access, and data exfiltration."}
